notes.summary: The page continues a lemma, introduces component notation and a reinforced axiom, then begins the section on residual contrées, support and cosupport. All live text, cancellations, raised material and two sets of connectors are included.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem was proved or re-proved. The possible semantic difference between a dot, ! and d prompted close inspection of the exponents, but visible strokes control the result. Likewise, membership would be natural before I, but the ink is a turnstile shape and is transcribed literally. The tuple comparison remains uncertain rather than being repaired from expected mathematics.
notes.author_checks: No explicit proof-check mark or verification by the author is claimed. C3 and cor. 1 are references only. No outside page or source was used.
